prompts.title: Recent Form: Rhythm of Results
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 sports montage, about eight seconds. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles and never place graphics there. Palette: charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for OFI Creta, slate #8ca6bf for Bayer Leverkusen. Editorial variant, prioritised: kinetic typography block. Spanish team names OFI Creta and Bayer Leverkusen slide in from opposite edges; the Spanish words Victorias, Empates and Derrotas stack as rhythmic type beats, each landing on a short off-beat pulse. No axes, no sample claims and no invented match events in this variant. The type canvas is a single focal point, with a thin lime vertical rule dividing teams. Statistical variant: grouped count bars for each team across victorias, empates and derrotas, counted in partidos. Shared baseline at the common origin, consistent bar width, one common scale across all six bars. Spanish labels: Victorias, Empates, Derrotas, Partidos. Bars use {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} for OFI Creta and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} for Bayer Leverkusen; each bar carries its resolved value. Source/sample annotation sits below the chart in small warm-white type: source Bzzoiro; sample OFI Creta {{home.n}} partidos; sample Bayer Leverkusen {{away.n}} partidos; keep sample badges attached and identify any unequal sample sizes. Entry: bars grow from the baseline while labels fade up; camera does a slow push-in. Main comparison: grouped bars side by side. Emphasis: the tallest resolved bar receives a brief lime pulse, no hardcoded leader. Transition: type beats collapse into bar labels, then the chart wipes to the next scene. Exit: bars shrink into the subtitle band and dissolve. All Spanish labels stay legible at mobile size, with restrained sports typography and one clear focal point.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against: Pitch to Chart
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about nine seconds. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for OFI Creta, slate #8ca6bf for Bayer Leverkusen. Editorial variant, prioritised: illustrative football pitch in minimal line art, with no specific match event and no invented score. A generic ball path arcs from one half to the other, then rebounds as an abstract defensive clear; the path is motion language, not a highlight. Spanish team names OFI Creta and Bayer Leverkusen appear as large type reveals at opposite ends. Spanish words Goles a favor and Goles recibidos orbit the pitch as energetic labels. No statistical axes and no sample claims in this variant. Statistical variant: paired horizontal bars for both teams, one pair for goles a favor and one pair for goles recibidos, shared scale in goles, common baseline, unambiguous colour key. Spanish labels: Goles a favor, Goles recibidos, Goles, Equipo. Values: OFI Creta {{home.gf}} and {{home.ga}}; Bayer Leverkusen {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}}. Source/sample annotation: source Bzzoiro; sample {{home.n}} partidos for OFI Creta and {{away.n}} partidos for Bayer Leverkusen. Entry: pitch lines draw on, then bars extend from the baseline; camera tilts from pitch to chart. Main comparison: attacking versus defensive counts for each team on the same scale within each category. Emphasis: the larger resolved bar in each pair gets a warm-white outline, never a predicted outcome. Transition: the ball path becomes a lime wipe that reveals the chart, then recedes. Exit: pitch fades to charcoal while bars settle and release to subtitles. Keep Spanish labels clear, keep football context explicit and maintain a single focal point.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets: Shield Wall
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about eight seconds. Permanent yellow subtitles occupy the lower quarter. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for OFI Creta, slate #8ca6bf for Bayer Leverkusen. Editorial variant, prioritised: stylised shield as a defensive energy motif. A split shield rotates into frame, lime on one side and slate on the other; concentric rings pulse outward like tackles and blocks, but no invented match events, no axes and no sample claims. Spanish team names OFI Creta and Bayer Leverkusen lock to each half of the shield. Spanish label Arcos en cero appears as a bold central stamp, with smaller kinetic words Defensa and Resistencia. The shield is the single focal point. Statistical variant: simple count bars for clean sheets, one bar per team, shared baseline, common scale in partidos. Spanish labels: Arcos en cero, Partidos, Equipo. Values: OFI Creta {{home.clean}}, Bayer Leverkusen {{away.clean}}. Do not convert counts into rates or proportions; show counts exactly as resolved. Source/sample annotation: source Bzzoiro; sample {{home.n}} partidos for OFI Creta and {{away.n}} partidos for Bayer Leverkusen, with sample badges kept beside team labels. Entry: shield splits, then bars grow from the baseline as labels fade in. Camera does a slow push-in, keeping type legible at mobile size and using a condensed sports face for Spanish labels. Main comparison: clean-sheet counts side by side. Emphasis: the larger resolved count receives a short lime edge glow, no hardcoded winner. Transition: shield halves slide apart into bar labels, then the chart wipes clean. Exit: bars retract into the subtitle band and dissolve to charcoal. Maintain professional hierarchy and one focal point throughout.

prompts.title: Recent Contrast: Wins and Goals
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about ten seconds. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for OFI Creta, slate #8ca6bf for Bayer Leverkusen. Editorial variant, prioritised: team reveals and narrative emphasis. OFI Creta and Bayer Leverkusen emerge as two large typographic blocks from opposite sides; the Spanish words Victorias and Goles a favor snap into place as chapter-like beats. No axes, no sample claims, no invented estimates and no predicted outcome. The composition keeps one focal point: a central seam of warm-white light that pulses with each label. Statistical variant: two mini-panels, one for victorias in partidos and one for goles in goles. Each panel uses its own common scale and shared baseline within that unit; never compare partidos directly with goles. Panel A shows {{home.wins}} and {{away.wins}}. Panel B shows {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}} and {{away.ga}} as paired bars. Spanish labels: Victorias, Goles a favor, Goles recibidos, Partidos, Goles. Source/sample annotation: source Bzzoiro; sample {{home.n}} partidos for OFI Creta and {{away.n}} partidos for Bayer Leverkusen. No published model estimates are supplied, so on-screen labels must distinguish history only and must not add a forecast. Entry: team reveal cards split into the two mini-panels; camera eases from the wide seam to the chart. Main comparison: recent win counts alongside goal production and concession counts, presented as a historical snapshot. Emphasis: the strongest resolved contrast in each panel gets a lime pulse, but with no claim about the next match. Transition: the central seam becomes a wipe that reveals the mini-panels, then narrows. Exit: panels fold into the subtitle band and fade to charcoal.
